claim: On July 22, 2025 Amazon MQ added Graviton3 powered m7g instances for RabbitMQ in sizes from medium to 16xlarge. RabbitMQ clusters on m7g instances deliver up to 50% higher workload capacity and up to 85% throughput improvements over comparable clusters on m5 instances.
question: What did the Graviton3 m7g instances add for Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ?

qualifiers.scope: Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ clusters on m7g instances compared with m5 instances
